newsitem.title: ITALY: Actor Liam Neeson released from hospital in Italy.
newsitem.headline: Actor Liam Neeson released from hospital in Italy.

text.p: Actor Liam Neeson was released from hospital in northern Italy on Monday after a week-long stay for treatment of an intestinal problem, doctors said.

Neeson was admitted to hospital in Padua on September 1 after he fell ill while attending the Venice Film Festival, which on Saturday awarded him its best actor prize for his role in Neil Jordan's IRA drama "Michael Collins".
It also drew the festival's Golden Lion prize for best film.
The movie, which also stars actress Julia Roberts, recounts the life of Collins, the IRA's former director of intelligence who helped fight for Ireland's independence from 1919 to 1921.
